stem: What is the central idea of the selection “Riding Out West”?

options.label: A
options.text: Trains allowed people to travel to new places.

options.label: B
options.text: Trains saved people money when they traveled.

options.label: C
options.text: El Paso became a famous city that people moved to.

options.label: D
options.text: El Paso was the first city in Texas to build a railroad.
